name: Sa Corruption
source:
[Mental Channel Open]
Hey?
Someone's there?
I need your help.

YOU must help Nuri escape the evil version of the strange hotel called “Lovers' Eden”, while keeping a close eye to hir “Corruption”.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/982770/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
【精神頻道已開啟】
喂？
有人嗎？
我需要你的幫助。

你必須幫助努里逃離名為「戀人伊甸」的詭異旅館的邪惡版本，同時密切關注其「腐化」程度。

[來源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/982770/]Steam[/url]]
